fields.name: decode_error
fields.unknown_nonzero_values: rejected; reachable values are constrained by vendor service in cross_field_constraints

cross_field_constraints: CONNECTING maps exactly to vendor tuple (service_id=1, service_version=101, message_id=1), return_or_error_code=0, ADDRESS_HASH_PRESENT=true, ERROR_TEXT_HASH_PRESENT=false, RESPONSE_MANIFEST_HASH_PRESENT=false, and response_entry_count=0
CONNECT_ERROR maps exactly to vendor tuple (1,101,2), return_or_error_code=0, ADDRESS_HASH_PRESENT=true, ERROR_TEXT_HASH_PRESENT=true, RESPONSE_MANIFEST_HASH_PRESENT=false, and response_entry_count=0
DISCONNECTED maps exactly to vendor tuple (1,101,3), return_or_error_code=0, ADDRESS_HASH_PRESENT=true, ERROR_TEXT_HASH_PRESENT=true, RESPONSE_MANIFEST_HASH_PRESENT=false, and response_entry_count=0

LOGON_SUCCESS and LOGON_FAILURE map exactly to vendor tuple (2,101,2), require RESPONSE_MANIFEST_HASH_PRESENT=true and both address/error hashes absent; success requires return_or_error_code=0 and failure requires a nonzero code

SUBSCRIPTION_ACCEPTED and SUBSCRIPTION_REJECTED map exactly to vendor tuple (2,101,23), require return_or_error_code=0 and RESPONSE_MANIFEST_HASH_PRESENT=true, and require both address/error hashes absent; SUBSCRIPTION_REJECTED additionally requires response_entry_count>0 because an empty status list is accepted
SERVICE_STATUS maps exactly to vendor tuple (2,101,5), permits its Version field in return_or_error_code, requires all three optional hashes absent, and limits response_entry_count to 4096
SESSION_STATUS maps exactly to vendor tuple (2,101,6), requires return_or_error_code=0 and all three optional hashes absent, and limits response_entry_count to 4096
LOGON and subscription response_entry_count is limited to 1000000

DECODE_ERROR maps only to recognized API message ids {1,2,3} or recognized SYS message ids {2,5,6,23}; API decode_error is in [0x0103,0x0106] and SYS decode_error is in [0x0203,0x0208]; local error 3 requires a service_version different from 101 and SCHEMA_UNKNOWN, while every later error requires service_version=101 and the matching DECODE_TRUNCATED or DECODE_OFFSET_INVALID quality bit; return_or_error_code and response_entry_count are zero, all three optional hashes are absent, and NONCANONICAL_EMPTY_OFFSET is not set in record flags
control_type is DECODE_ERROR if and only if decode_error is nonzero
origin_record_end_wal_pos is at least 4096 and is 8-byte aligned
required_count is in [1,64], optional_count is at most 64-required_count
required_ok_count + required_failed_count does not exceed required_count; validation is performed without unsigned overflow
optional_ok_count + optional_failed_count does not exceed optional_count; validation is performed without unsigned overflow
RESPONSE_MANIFEST_HASH_PRESENT is set if and only if response_manifest_sha256 is not all zero
ADDRESS_HASH_PRESENT is set if and only if address_sha256 is not all zero
ERROR_TEXT_HASH_PRESENT is set if and only if error_text_sha256 is not all zero
REQUIRED_FAILURE is set if and only if required_failed_count is nonzero
OPTIONAL_FAILURE is set if and only if optional_failed_count is nonzero
if NONCANONICAL_EMPTY_OFFSET is set in flags, NONCANONICAL_EMPTY_OFFSET is also set in quality_flags

ControlRecord quality_flags may contain only SUBSCRIPTION_CHANGED, UNAUTHORIZED, NONCANONICAL_EMPTY_OFFSET, SCHEMA_UNKNOWN, DECODE_TRUNCATED, DECODE_OFFSET_INVALID, SESSION_UNKNOWN, SOURCE_DISCONNECTED, CONNECTION_SWITCHED, and RAW_RECOVERED_APPEND_ONLY
SOURCE_DISCONNECTED, UNAUTHORIZED, any decode-quality bit, CONNECTING, CONNECT_ERROR, DISCONNECTED, LOGON_FAILURE, and DECODE_ERROR each imply SESSION_UNKNOWN
CONNECT_ERROR and DISCONNECTED imply SOURCE_DISCONNECTED unless a sticky decode-quality bit proves the decoder was already poisoned and therefore did not mutate the disconnected-window state
LOGON_SUCCESS has SESSION_UNKNOWN if and only if a sticky decode-quality bit is present, which represents an already-poisoned state
decoder_checks: magic, version, header_size, and record_size equal their fixed values
record_crc32c matches the declared CRC domain
all field and cross-field constraints pass
encoder_behavior: the output buffer is initialized to zero before fields are stored
the input model record_crc32c value is not serialized; record_crc32c is computed after all other fields are stored

unknown_value_policy.decode_error_values: reject outside the exact reachable API set 0x0103..0x0106 and SYS set 0x0203..0x0208, including the service-version and required-quality correlations
